title: MaterialsScience NanoparticleSynthSOP

stats.done_summary: Successfully converted lab scratch notes (lab_scratch.txt) into an executable Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for pilot-scale copper nanoparticle synthesis. Generated: (1) comprehensive SOP document (outputs/nanoparticle_sop.md) with 12 sections covering purpose, scope, responsibilities, materials, safety, procedure, quality control, and documentation; (2) three visualization aids - synthesis workflow diagram, temperature profile chart, and process parameters table; (3) complete research report (report/report.md) documenting the methodology, results, and discussion of the conversion process.
